nodes.label: Portable scientific and serialization package lower bounds
nodes.rationale: Requirements specify minimum NumPy 1.26, pandas 2.2, matplotlib 3.8, scikit-learn 1.5, SciPy 1.11 and joblib 1.3. Lower bounds do not constitute a full reproducibility lock or prove compatibility of every later version.

nodes.label: Portable notebook execution and export lower bounds
nodes.rationale: Minimum versions are declared for nbformat 5.10, nbclient 0.10, ipykernel 6.29 and nbconvert 7.16. This is a dependency specification; it does not itself demonstrate successful notebook execution.
